lessons.title: Platform, configuration and data
lessons.text:
Platform, configuration and data
Model actual 1C execution and choose an environment supporting the task being verified.
File skills and synthetic-data discipline; A1 is optional.
Draw platform, configuration and infobase boundaries.
Separate visualization, static analysis and execution.
Explain checks that OneScript cannot replace.
The platform executes an application model
1C development involves more than a text language. Configuration defines metadata, forms, modules, rights and other application elements. The platform uses that definition to organize UI, storage and execution. A single BSL file is therefore not an application configuration. Access to catalog managers, documents and registers depends on metadata and execution context.
In the service desk, separate the Request type definition, request instances and operations on them. A query against a nonexistent catalog does not become valid because an editor highlights its name. An architectural error can precede a syntax error: a grammatically valid call may target an object absent from the application. Establish the model before choosing an execution location.
Three different evidence modes
A visualization presents a simplified model. It can explain a causal relationship but cannot establish execution. Static analysis examines text and available descriptions without running the application scenario. Execution invokes an actual environment with a configuration, inputs and state. These modes must not silently substitute for one another.
Candidate diagrams use JavaScript and are explicitly labeled as learning models. Separately, the official platform executed ManagedApplicationModule.bsl using three in-memory synthetic records, a 105-minute sum and two negative cases. That does not prove document posting, concurrent transactions or a server cluster: the probe contains none of those mechanisms.
Context matters more than extension
A .bsl extension identifies module text, not its execution location. Client form modules, server common modules and object modules expose different objects and events. P1 uses a managed application module in a separate file infobase. P8 examines client/server directives in depth; for now, record context with every example.
OneScript is a separate virtual machine with a related language. It can serve automation and a bounded subset of language exercises, but it does not automatically supply 1C metadata, managed forms or registers. A successful .os run does not prove .bsl behavior in a configuration. Compatibility requires a matrix of types, collections, conversions, exceptions and contexts before it can be offered as a substitute.
Environment limits belong in architecture
Training edition has volume limits, one session and no client/server mode. It cannot establish concurrent access behavior or password authentication. The community path supports broader development tasks but requires official registration and compliance with its terms. Basic P1 requires neither a deployed server nor Nexus infrastructure changes.
Choose the smallest adequate environment: official file-mode platform for P1; separate approval for network and concurrency experiments. Preserve full version, module source, inputs and actual output. A second person can then reproduce the check and distinguish the proven mechanism from a future project.

lessons.title: File infobase and a reproducible workspace
lessons.text:
File infobase and a reproducible workspace
Create a disposable official workspace, verify recovery and preserve enough information to repeat the experiment.
P1.1; legitimately installed official platform.
Reproduce creation and loading of original configuration.
Verify that the destination is new.
Distinguish exit status from sufficient acceptance evidence.
Reproducibility fixes the conditions
“Works on my machine” omits version, starting state and inputs. A repeatable experiment needs full platform version, infobase type, metadata, modules, operation order and success criteria. A course name cannot replace these details. Installed 8.3.27.2214 and downloadable Windows training 8.3.27.1508 are different builds; transferring evidence requires a separate run.
The Nexus native kit contains original empty-configuration metadata and a managed application module. It includes no Accounting, BGU or ZGU configuration and no third-party records. Metadata UUIDs describe learning objects and are not licenses. Platform installers are excluded and obtained through official sources.
Create without overwriting
Choose a nonexistent experiment directory before running the gate. Existing destinations are rejected rather than silently cleared. The base is created in base; recovery uses restored. No path is taken from the owner’s infobase list, and adding the experiment to the shared startup list is unnecessary.
A new directory is necessary but insufficient: the protocol must confirm it was actually used. Do not put real logins or passwords in command arguments. An empty learning infobase needs neither. If an installation requires activation or personal sign-in, leave that separate owner action explicit instead of bypassing access.
Preserve structure and state separately
Exporting configuration files supports review and Git. Dumping an infobase transfers a particular infobase state. Recovery verification needs a second new instance and comparison after loading. P1 has no persisted application records, so this experiment verifies configuration and execution recovery, not future documents.
After restore, the same probe must produce the expected line again. This is stronger than simply finding a .dt file. A5/P5 will require control IDs, document counts, relations and register totals. Design evidence alongside the data model rather than after the interface.
Read an automated protocol carefully
Exit code 0 says the command reported no failure; it does not establish the intended result. The gate also requires a BSL output file and exact matching contents. A syntax check needs a negative control: a deliberately broken module must be detected. Otherwise, you may be checking an empty infobase or a different module.
Preserve safe operation logs and source hashes, not licensing files or personal paths from unknown workspaces. Distinguish native AUTOMATED PASS, learner manual LIVE PASS and NOT RUN. An absence of log errors is not evidence of educational effectiveness.

lessons.title: Metadata, update lifecycle and first BSL
lessons.text:
Metadata, update lifecycle and first BSL
Trace a source change to actual output and check positive and negative cases.
P1.1–P1.2; ability to follow a sequence. P2 studies syntax in depth.
Distinguish working and database configurations.
Read arrays, structures and a loop in the first example.
Explain how a test rejects incorrect behavior.
A change has multiple states
Editing a file does not change a running infobase. Load and check the development configuration, apply it to database configuration, then launch the application and reconcile behavior. Skipping a link leads to a common mistake: reading new source while executing the previous configuration.
The kit places the module at Ext/ManagedApplicationModule.bsl. The platform invokes ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы when a managed application starts. It registers no real documents: the array stores three structures in process memory. Exiting does not turn those values into a request table.
Read the example through its data flow
A structure groups named values Код, Минуты and Статус. An array stores a sequence of structures. The For Each loop visits three elements, checks each status and adds minutes to the running sum, initially zero. After the loop, count and sum are checked: 3 and 105. Work grows in proportion to the element count.
Focus on data flow before memorizing syntax. Identify how the second request contributes 45 minutes. Removing it must change both count and total. If a modified experiment leaves output unchanged, check whether the new module was loaded and database configuration updated. Saved editor text does not establish that.
Checks need negative cases
ДопустимыйСтатус accepts only New, In progress and Closed in their source Russian strings. Separate checks reject an empty string and Оплачена. Two negative inputs do not prove all future rules, but they catch overly broad behavior such as accepting every nonempty string.
ПроверитьУсловие raises an exception on a false condition, so PASS follows successful checks rather than appearing independently. The native gate also tests configuration analysis using a syntactically broken separate copy. Never change expected values merely to obtain green results: first explain the changed requirement and necessary checks.
Output and measurable limits
The expected line records item count, minute total and negative-case count. Automation passes its result-file path as a startup parameter inside the new test directory. A manual launch without that parameter displays the message and leaves the application available for observation.
This demonstrates official BSL execution and one reproducible learning computation. It does not demonstrate persisted requests, transactions, Mastery or learner independence. Preserve source and actual output together; either alone leaves uncertainty about the program that ran.

lessons.title: Designer, EDT, Git and diagnostics
lessons.text:
Designer, EDT, Git and diagnostics
Choose tools by task, preserve a reviewable change and diagnose failures from evidence.
P1.1–P1.3. EDT is optional for the first native module.
Compare Designer, EDT, OneScript and BSL LS.
Prepare a useful diff and test record.

A development environment is not the runtime
Designer ships with the platform and is the reproducible P1 path. EDT is a separate Eclipse-based environment supporting projects and Git. It can target different platform versions and infobases, but running an application still requires the platform. Having an EDT project does not establish successful application to an infobase.
At the audit date the official website offers EDT 2026.2.2. We do not claim it is installed or tested with our workspace. Redistribution rights cannot be inferred from Eclipse licensing; the product and components need a separate check. Designer is sufficient for P1; EDT remains an optional additional validation path.
Highlighting, BSL LS and OneScript
BSL Language Server supplies analysis and editor capabilities. Its LGPL license and diagnostics do not turn it into a 1C engine. The candidate does not integrate it and therefore makes no BSL LS static PASS claim. Native configuration checking is a separate executed mechanism with a version and negative control.
OneScript uses MPL-2.0 and executes an independent language implementation. It may support bounded language exercises but cannot stand in for 1C forms or registers. Neither OneScript nor BSL LS is added to mandatory Nexus startup. A provider/bridge decision needs 02/01 coordination and a threat model rather than a catalog flag change.
Git preserves an explainable change
A commit should connect the problem, change and verification. Preserve sources, a concise protocol and safe evidence. Exclude working infobases, licensing files, personal connection parameters and installers. Reviewers need to see the changed module and the test expectations justifying it. Project commit messages are in Russian.
Avoid diverging copies of shared definitions. The course glossary is versioned and referenced by lessons, while learning results remain course-specific. A future shared-content update must not silently reinterpret a saved attempt; it needs a new version and compatibility review.
Diagnose from observation to hypothesis
When output is absent, first identify the completed stage: creation, loading, checking, update or execution. Then compare version, directory and source hash. File-access failure does not prove missing licensing; syntax failure does not prove a broken platform. State a narrow hypothesis that one safe experiment can falsify.
During author verification, access to a new infobase file was initially denied by the execution environment. The same operation on that same isolated workspace succeeded with permitted local access. We preserved the failed attempt and explanation without inventing a platform defect or touching production. Record problem → hypothesis → attempt → result → decision → regression.

lessons.title: BSL tokens, variables and expression evaluation
lessons.text:
BSL tokens, variables and expression evaluation
Read and change a short BSL algorithm, predict its evaluation and verify it in the official platform rather than a browser imitation.
P1; your own A2/P2 workspace copy. A completion is not required.
Distinguish identifiers, keywords, literals and operators.
Explain assignment and comparison in context.
Check operator precedence and equivalent Russian/English keyword variants.
Text becomes an algorithm in a particular module
A token is a meaningful piece of source: a name, number, string, keyword or operator. In Итог = Первое + Второе; the names identify variables, plus selects an operation and the semicolon terminates the statement. Quoting 30 produces string literal "30"; without quotes it is a number. Similar-looking text does not establish identical values or permitted operations. A comment explains intent but performs no calculation.
The source belongs to the learning configuration’s managed application module. The platform invokes its startup handler, which calls the checks. A .bsl file alone does not launch an application: configuration, execution context and a function call are required. The test block targets the managed thick client. Moving manager calls into a thin client or JavaScript requires a separate environment decision.
A variable holds a value; an expression produces one
Assignment evaluates the right-hand side and stores its result in the left-hand variable. A BSL variable’s type follows its current value; input types still need deliberate control. Naming a variable Minutes does not turn text into a number. Trace state explicitly: inputs 30 and 45 make ДобавитьМинуты return 75. That returned value is not yet persisted in an infobase document.
The equals sign has different contextual roles. A standalone Итог = 75; assigns, while Итог = 75 inside a check compares. Read the surrounding construction rather than one symbol. Distinguish evaluation, returning from a function and writing an object. Each mechanism needs its own check; a correct printed result does not establish all platform behavior.
Predict evaluation order first
In 4 + 2 * 3, multiplication happens first and the result is 10. Parentheses in (4 + 2) * 3 change grouping and produce 18. Tested BSL division 3 / 2 yields 1.5, so assumptions about integer division from another language are unsafe. The platform checks all three expectations in P2.1.* cases. Preserve intermediate values to locate the first divergence.
Plus also concatenates strings: "REQ-" + "001" yields "REQ-001". This neither adds business identifiers nor creates a document. Select operations according to type and meaning. Here the addition function assumes numeric inputs; it implements no general user-text parser. P2.2 examines those boundaries so a useful small function is not mistaken for complete real-data validation.
Two keyword spellings, one testable meaning
Функция/Возврат/КонецФункции and Function/Return/EndFunction can express the same algorithm. Our module separately calls ДобавитьМинуты and AddMinutes with 30 and 45, obtaining 75. Your function names, metadata attributes and string values are not translated automatically. An English lesson interface does not turn the Клиенты catalog name into a different configuration object.
After predicting results, run the native gate and inspect its six P2.1 cases. A separate negative copy replaces addition with subtraction. Syntax checking accepts it, but actual case P2.1.russian-keywords reports FAIL. This separates valid grammar from meeting a requirement. Preserve the original module, expected 75 and successful protocol rather than making the incorrect copy the new reference.

lessons.title: Types, Undefined, Null and explicit conversion
lessons.text:
Types, Undefined, Null and explicit conversion
Separate absent values from a valid zero and check input before evaluating it, without relying on variable names or accidental conversion.
P2.1; functions, expressions and the real native gate.
Inspect value types with TypeOf/ТипЗнч.
Distinguish Undefined, Null, strings, numbers and domain validity.
Check explicit conversion and a failing conversion case.
Value type and field requirements
BSL’s flexible typing allows a variable to hold different value types over time. A program must still decide what a particular operation permits. For minutes we first check ТипЗнч(Значение)=Тип("Число"), then the range 0..1440. String "30" resembles a number but fails this contract. Parsing it requires separate rules rather than silently passing it to arithmetic.
Separate three questions: the value’s type, whether an operation accepts that type, and whether the value satisfies a domain rule. -1 is a Number but is not an admissible duration here. Zero is also a Number and is permitted. Variable names, highlighting and presentation answer none of these questions. Record type and expected decision separately from displayed text.
Different forms of absence
Undefined and Null have different types, verified by separate native cases. Undefined can represent an unavailable value; Null also matters in data handling, including future query results. This lesson does not declare them interchangeable, equal to zero or equivalent to JavaScript null. It compares their types; query-specific Null semantics are studied in P7.
An empty catalog reference is another distinct situation. It retains that catalog’s reference type but identifies no particular customer. A2 disallows it in a request. Empty strings, numeric zero, False and empty references must not be grouped under one vague “empty” rule when field requirements differ. Establish field meaning before choosing a validation function.
ValueIsFilled is not universal validation
On the tested platform, ЗначениеЗаполнено(0) returns False. Using it as the sole duration validator would reject an allowed zero. ЭтоЧислоМинут instead checks type and range separately. This illustrates meaning-driven validation, not a blanket rejection of ValueIsFilled: it is appropriate for the mandatory customer reference in this workspace.
A useful input matrix includes zero, an ordinary number, the upper boundary, negative and excessive values, a string and Undefined. Record a distinct expectation for each. A few positive cases cannot reveal zero being mistaken for absence or text passing unnoticed. Test counts are useful only alongside their actual meaning and exercised boundaries.
Conversion is an explicit decision that can fail
Число("12") returns 12 in the native case. Число("не число") raises an exception; a separate Try/Except block confirms that rejection. Do not continue with a variable’s accidental previous value or declare the input valid after a conversion failure. Parsing failure differs from a domain rejection: even a successfully parsed -1 must still fail the minutes rule.
Parsing localized fractional text needs a separate input-format contract. No claim is made that every comma, space or currency symbol is accepted identically. P2.5 separates formatting from values; this basic validator expects an already numeric input. Preserve synthetic input, decision and observed exception rather than real user data. This keeps the experiment repeatable and safe.

lessons.title: Conditions, Boolean expressions and decision tables
lessons.text:
Conditions, Boolean expressions and decision tables
Build a complete decision table for request duration and verify branch order, types and boundaries in real BSL.
P2.1–P2.2; type versus validity and the ЭтоЧислоМинут function.
Translate requirements into nonoverlapping input classes.
Explain If/ElsIf/Else and And/Or/Not.
Find a boundary defect through a counterexample rather than random trials.
Define the rule before coding
КлассДлительности has an explicit contract. Nonnumeric inputs and numbers outside 0..1440 are rejected. Zero maps to NoCost; positive values through 60 inclusive is Short; values above 60 through 1440 is Long. This is a learning classification, not a medical, employment or financial standard. Changing class names or boundaries requires changing requirements and tests deliberately.
Before reading the implementation, build a table for -1, 0, 1, 60, 61, 1440, 1441 and string "60", recording types separately. The table reveals missing classes or ambiguous boundaries. An ordinary input such as 30 cannot distinguish the intended algorithm from one that treats 60 as Long or accepts textual input unexpectedly.
Branch ordering changes behavior
The first branch calls ЭтоЧислоМинут and rejects an invalid input. Zero is handled next, then <=60, then the remaining admissible range. An If/ElsIf chain takes the first matching branch. Reaching the final Else establishes that type and range are valid, the value is nonzero and it exceeds 60. These accumulated facts explain the final branch.
Placing a broad <=60 branch before the zero case classifies zero as Short. Replacing <= with < makes 60 Long. Both variants can pass syntax checking. Include inputs that distinguish these implementations. For each experiment, record the first incorrect result and its cause instead of adding arbitrary exceptions that conceal an ordering defect.
Boolean expressions and safe preconditions
Value>=0 And Value<=1440 requires both bounds simultaneously. Or can combine reasons for rejection, while Not reverses a Boolean predicate. Read a compound expression as a claim about a particular input. When combining business rules, decide whether both or at least one must hold before choosing an operator. Parentheses make grouping explicit.
This implementation returns early on a wrong type before comparing numeric bounds. Correctness does not depend on side effects or guesses about right-hand evaluation. These exercises use True/False; query-specific Null behavior is not imported automatically. If an input can represent a third special meaning, handle it before applying a two-valued decision table.
What the evidence establishes
The native suite checks -1, 0, 60, 61, 1440, 1441 and string "60" in seven separate P2.3 cases. They exercise important current boundaries, not every number, fractional duration or future textual format. The goal is to justify test selection and explain limitations. A PASS count without its actual input set provides less information.
Proposed properties could include every admissible positive input <=60 being Short, rejected input leaving infobase state unchanged, and repeated calls returning the same class. These remain proposed until tested. This pure function classifies a value and writes no document. A2’s BeforeWrite rules are a separate boundary and cannot be declared verified by classification alone.

lessons.title: Loops: tracing, termination and boundary datasets
lessons.text:
Loops: tracing, termination and boundary datasets
Calculate an aggregate, explain loop termination and check empty or invalid input without modifying source values.
P2.1–P2.3; valid-minute predicates and branching.
Match For, While and For Each to tasks.
Trace accumulators and counters.
Explain Break/Continue and verify that the input array remains unchanged.
Repetition needs state and a stopping argument
A loop repeats actions, but a useful algorithm explains what changes and when repetition stops. For suits a known range; For Each traverses collection elements; While checks a condition before each step. The construct alone proves nothing. Explain progress toward termination for While and the finite source collection for traversal.
СуммаМинут accepts an array of numeric durations. Its initial total is zero and each valid element is added once. For [30,45,0], accumulator states are 0→30→75→75. The array still contains three elements: the function neither removes nor overwrites them. It processes an in-memory array, not automatically every document in the infobase. A2’s separate code checks real persisted documents.
An invariant locates the first wrong step
After processing the first k elements, the accumulator equals their sum. This invariant also explains an empty array: no step executes and the result remains zero. An arbitrary initial total or skipping the first item can produce a wrong final result without revealing the cause. A k→item→before/after trace locates the first divergence.
Each element passes ЭтоЧислоМинут before addition. A negative element raises an exception instead of being ignored silently. That is the selected contract: a partial dataset must not resemble a complete valid aggregate. Collecting errors while continuing is another possible design, but it needs a separate result structure and tests. Do not mix strategies without changing the task explicitly.
Boundaries and loop control
The verified For loop from 1 through 3 visits 1,2,3 and sums to 6. A While counter starting at zero and incrementing while <3 finishes at 3. Termination follows from the counter update, not from hoping someone stops the program. Bound manual experiments in advance; hanging a process is not a useful infinite-loop test.
Continue skips the remainder of the current iteration; Break ends the loop. A native 1..5 example skips 2 and stops before adding 4, so only 1 and 3 contribute and the result is 4. Five is never considered after Break. This trace distinguishes the commands more precisely than saying both “exit the loop.”
Evidence coverage and remaining work
Seven P2.4 cases check aggregation, preserved input count, an empty array, inclusive For bounds, While termination, Continue/Break and rejection of an invalid item. This finite set is not a large-data performance measurement. A simple sum visits elements proportionally to collection size; field p95, server execution and concurrent collection changes are not measured.

lessons.text:
Numbers, dates, strings and explicit interchange formats
Separate values from presentation, verify numeric/date calculations and define boundaries for localized input.

A numeric value differs from its string
On the tested BSL platform, 0.1+0.2 equals 0.3. This comes from an actual native case, not a browser calculation. Do not import another runtime’s binary or formatting assumptions without testing them. The learning formula Minutes*Rate/60 yields 300 for 30 minutes at an hourly rate of 600. Establish units, evaluation order and input preconditions first.
УчебнаяСтоимость assumes numeric inputs and is not a general financial calculator. It defines no currency, tax, negative-rate validation or rounding policy. Correct output 300 for one case proves none of those rules. The P2 duration predicate checks type and range, not integrality; fractional-minute policy must likewise be an explicit requirement rather than an implication of the field name.
Separate formatting from parsing
Формат(12.5, "ЧДЦ=2; ЧРД=.; ЧГ=0") produces string "12.50" in the native case: two fractional digits, a decimal point and no grouping are explicit. The original value remains numeric; formatting returns a presentation. If another system consumes the text, define an interchange format and check that consumer. Attractive interface output is not automatically an agreed protocol.
Strings "12,50", "12.50" and "12 500" can depend on input rules and locale. This lesson does not promise identical conversion for arbitrary text. An explicit output format does not automatically make parsing reversible. Specify a parser, allowed separators, error behavior and range. Replacing every comma with a period is not proven support for all locales; enumerate accepted and rejected inputs first.
Construct dates from components and define their meaning
The native suite constructs Дата(2026,10,31,9,30,0). It checks year, month and day separately, then adds 60 seconds and verifies a difference of 60. Components avoid ambiguous strings such as 03/04/2026, which can mean March or April depending on convention. The exercise uses a fixed date rather than the computer’s changing clock.
A calendar value alone establishes no UTC or external-timezone agreement. For interchange, define whether it represents local event time, a date-only document attribute or an instant on a shared timeline. Timezone and daylight-saving transitions were not tested in this workspace. Adding 60 seconds successfully at one calendar value does not complete an integration design.
Strings, units and closing the P2 package
СтрДлина("Заявка") returns 6 in a separate native case. That is not a UTF-8 byte count or a universal guarantee about visible characters in every Unicode sequence. Text length, SHA256 and encoded file size answer different questions. Customer codes C001 and document numbers A200001 are identifiers, not quantities to add arithmetically.

lessons.text:
Module contexts and exports
Extract a common-module computation contract and check call availability by context.

A module belongs to a context
BSL text belongs to an application, object, form or common module. Placement determines available data: an object module sees the attributes of its object, while a common module does not receive them automatically. Pass minutes and rate explicitly so calculation does not depend on an open form. Identical function names in different modules do not make the functions identical.
The service-desk calculation may be called from a card, document and report. Separate formulas let one fix leave two old implementations behind. A common computation contract avoids that divergence but needs explicit inputs. List every caller and verify equal units, parameter meaning and result type rather than merely matching function names.
Export defines a call surface
Export permits calls from an available external context; it does not create an unrestricted network API. A common module has separate client, server and server-call settings. A pure calculation needs only the necessary contexts. A public function validates its inputs even when a screen has already performed similar checks.
Describe a function by inputs, preconditions, result and permitted changes. Cost uses numeric minutes/rate, admissible ranges, a rounded number and unchanged input collections. This description selects tests before implementation. If failure returns another type, callers must know explicitly or an error can accidentally participate in arithmetic. A stable contract makes substitution and review possible.
Make dependencies visible
Hidden reads of a current document or global variable make a calculation state-dependent. Tests with identical inputs may then depend on a previous window or execution order. Procedures, functions and parameters
Design a calculation function with explicit inputs, return value and mutation contract.

Procedures act, functions return
A procedure suits a command; a function suits a computed value. Return ends the current function call, not the whole session. Parameters and mutation

Val does not turn a mutable collection into a deep copy: adding an element may remain visible outside. If input must be preserved, construct a new collection or avoid mutating methods. Order, named fields and keys
An array stores a sequence with zero-based indices, useful for traversing request lines. A structure describes a small record with known property names, such as Minutes and Rate. A map associates an admissible key with a value, such as a customer reference with an accumulated total. Choose by required operations rather than storing everything in one familiar type.

Exceptions and diagnosable failures

Exceptions change control flow
Try/Except catches an error within a defined region. Execution does not automatically continue through the remaining Try statements after a failure. The service-desk calculation may be called from a card, document and report. Separate formulas let one fix leave two old implementations behind. Domain model and identity
Design customer identity and duplicate policy independently of display names.

Entity and key
A customer outlives one request. Its internal reference distinguishes it from another item even with the same name. An external code supports imports but needs its own uniqueness scope. Define which event creates a customer and which only updates the existing presentation.
Model changes as well as creation. Customers can be renamed, services repriced, and requests can retain earlier agreed terms. List these events separately to identify catalog data, document snapshots and historical facts. This prevents silently updating every linked request when only current presentation or a current service offering should change.
Normalization is not a business decision
Trimming spaces and case normalization can help compare codes but may collapse distinct identifiers. Normalized names do not prove identity. Define a unique teaching codeC001 and reject collisions with a different entity. Repeating an import must not increase item count.
Internal identity and external code solve different problems. References connect infobase objects; codes support imported correspondence. Define uniqueness scope, case handling and absence policy. Two systems can reuse one code for different customers, requiring sender scope or a mapping table. A name search alone cannot resolve this ambiguity safely or justify replacing an existing entity.
References preserve relationships
A document stores a customer reference. Renaming should change presentation without breaking requests. Replacing the reference with a string loses relational identity and complicates updates. Key migration needs a mapping and checks of dependent objects; mass renaming alone is insufficient.
Keep empty references, missing items and deletion-marked objects distinct and define each outcome. An old request must not silently point to a newly created lookalike after reseeding. Compare identities and document relationships before/after; use labels only for human readability. A valid-looking card can otherwise conceal broken history or a duplicate entity.
Verify idempotent creation
Seed twice and compare references, count and attributes. Add equal names with different codes to expose name-based lookup errors. Concurrent creation under one code needs a transactional solution; single-user repetition does not prove it. P10 addresses that boundary.
Use an ordinary customer, an equal-named second customer and a request-free third customer. Test lookup, rename, reseed and selection. Facts by key
An information register suits rates by service and time. Service is a dimension, rate a resource, and period adds history. An attribute stores extra description rather than replacing the key. Start from “which rate applied toS1 atD”; one current card price cannot answer the historical question.
Choose a register from the data question. “Which rate applied?” needs keyed temporal state;“how much was delivered this week?” needs turnover;“what obligation remains?” needs balance. Periodicity limits distinguishable states
Two records for one service in one period follow the key policy. Daily periodicity cannot distinguish two intraday changes under the same key. Do not substitute current time just to bypass a collision. Choose required precision and test exactly at a rate-change boundary.
Dimensions define slices, resources measured quantities, and recorders provenance where supported. Adding a dimension changes keys and granularity:customer totals may split by service. A slice is not a sum of prices
Between changes, use the latest applicable rate rather than summing history. SliceLast represents state at a time; record sets represent history. Explicitly return absence or reject when no prior rate exists. Automatic zero can resemble a free service and hide missing data.
Time boundaries belong in specifications. State uses an as-of moment, turnover an interval, and movements an agreed period. Test before the first fact, exactly at a change and after it. One brand, several different things
“Install 1C” is an incomplete specification. The platform supplies common mechanisms: windows, infobase access, module execution and data operations. A configuration describes a domain: which customers, requests and services exist, what can be saved and how results are calculated. An infobase holds a particular application instance and its data. Several infobases can use one installed platform. A shortcut label therefore does not establish that the intended infobase is open.
In our service desk, Request as a future document type belongs to the configuration. Request REQ-001 from invented customer Alpha is data. Version 8.3.27.2214 identifies the platform. Confusing these layers can make you mistake a software update for a data transfer or submit configuration sources instead of completed work. Separate the layers before making your first change.
What an application contributes
The platform does not inherently know what “request closed” means. The application defines that rule. Identical words in different configurations may represent different actions. Saving generally persists an object state; posting reflects a business event according to configuration rules. Posting does not automatically mean payment or completion. A1 establishes vocabulary and a model; actual catalogs and documents are introduced in later modules.
The learning model contains three requests lasting 30, 45 and 30 minutes. Their sum is 105 minutes, but this is not yet revenue, employee workload or paid labor: we have not defined those rules. A careful user checks the meaning, unit and selection behind a metric before drawing conclusions. This habit is more useful than memorizing button positions.
Training edition and community licensing
The official training edition supports creating configurations and practicing without a purchase. Its limitations include file mode, a single session and restricted data volumes; user passwords and operating-system authentication are unavailable. Consequently, entering without a password in this edition proves nothing about production security. All course records are invented.
Community licensing is a different official development path. The official page specifies platform 8.3.23 or later and registration with phone verification. It does not authorize operating a learning workspace for real management or accounting. Free acquisition does not mean permission to repackage the installer in Nexus. Basic A1 needs only a file-based training workspace, without a server or purchased license.
Record a result that can be checked

1C:Enterprise mode runs an application. Users open lists, enter records, build reports and perform permitted operations. Designer supports development and administration: metadata, modules, forms and maintenance operations. Being able to open Designer does not establish that every change is safe. Access, competence and agreed scope are different questions.
A role determines permitted application operations. A form may hide a button for convenience, but a hidden button alone does not prove access control. Training edition omits some authentication mechanisms. We can study least privilege, while full sign-in and user-separation checks require an environment that actually supports them.
Three classes of change
Changing data means entering an invented request or fixing its description. A user setting changes a filter or column selection when the application exposes that option. Configuration changes add an attribute to the request type, change its type or introduce an event handler. The distinction follows the effect, not the number of clicks. A single Designer action may affect the structure of every record.
Suppose a consultant wants only open requests. If an existing filter supports this, a setting is enough. Storing a closure reason absent from the model may need a configuration change. Do not start by adding a field: first check whether an existing attribute already serves the purpose, how it is filled and which reports use it. This avoids unnecessary complexity.
Development has its own lifecycle
An edited working configuration and the database configuration are different states. Saving an application definition does not ensure that a running session already uses the new rule. A developer checks the change, updates the database configuration and separately verifies execution. A1 establishes this sequence; hands-on configuration starts in A4.
Before an update, preserve a recoverable copy. Changing an attribute type can affect stored values; an empty-looking form does not establish preservation. Agree on expected effects, then verify existing records, negative cases and recovery on a copy. The interactive diagram illustrates this process without performing an update.
Hand off a reproducible task
A useful developer request contains context, expected behavior, observed behavior and reproduction steps. “1C is broken” does not identify a test. “Filtering Status = New in the learning infobase also shows REQ-002 with status In progress” provides a checkable case. Include a synthetic example and state whether the problem remains after clearing other filters.
Do not send passwords, licensing details or a full production archive. Our course needs only a synthetic set, platform version, configuration name and chosen mode. When a task exceeds your authority, preserve a reproducible example and stop the change. This is a professional outcome, not a failure.

lessons.text:
Navigation, objects and a learning request
Read an interface as a view of a domain model and verify meaning instead of guessing from window appearance.
A1.1 and A1.2.
Distinguish a list, catalog item, document and report.
Trace a request from a row to related records.

The configuration shapes the interface
Sections, commands and forms differ between applications. A universal instruction such as “press the third button on the left” ages quickly. Identify the purpose: a request list shows records, a request form shows one object, a report processes selected data. An empty list can indicate no records, a filter or restricted access. Test these hypotheses separately.
A1 provides a Nexus model with three requests. It supports learning to read rows and totals on a phone without an installed platform. The model is explicitly labeled and is not a 1C window. An actual empty infobase contains none of these documents; do not search for menus its configuration has not defined.
Catalogs, documents and references
Catalogs commonly hold relatively stable domain objects such as customers and services. Documents commonly represent events or operations over time. This is a useful starting point, while exact behavior remains configuration-specific. “Alpha” is a customer presentation; the relation should preserve object identity, not merely a copied name string. Two customers can share a presentation.
REQ-001 and REQ-003 refer to one invented customer. Renaming that customer should not create a second identity. Repeatedly typing names instead of retaining references causes inconsistent spelling and grouping. A2 examines items and references in the official environment; here, learn to recognize the relationship in a data set.
Filters change the visible set
Search helps locate a record; a filter specifies membership conditions. Conditions can combine, so record every active restriction before diagnosing a result. Status = New selects only REQ-001. Customer = Alpha selects REQ-001 and REQ-003. Durations total 105 minutes for all requests and 60 for Alpha. These are arithmetic control values, not measured service productivity.
A zero-valued row and no row are different observations. A report omitting closed requests does not prove deletion. Remove filters, locate the source document and inspect report settings first. Sorting changes presentation order; it does not by itself change the sum of selected values.
Verify a user scenario
Start with known input data and a goal, such as finding Alpha’s requests and explaining their states. Verify identifiers as well as row count: two wrong records still produce a count of two. Then inspect an empty selection to distinguish no results from a loading error.
Model controls select statuses and show request details. This trains navigation without persisting 1C data. Candidate notes are separate per course; moving to P does not automatically award A1 completion. Identify the observation source in your protocol: Nexus model or official platform.

lessons.text:
Separate infobase, verification and a safe copy
Create a reproducible workspace and prove that continuing in another course creates new work while preserving the source.
A1.1–A1.3; access to an officially installed platform.
Create a file infobase in a new directory.

Isolation starts with the path
A learning infobase needs its own directory and a clear name. Do not select an arbitrary infobase from a shared list. Before creating it, verify that the target directory is new and the source work remains intact. Never restore over an existing infobase. Isolation protects working data from learning mistakes and makes the experiment repeatable.
Use the platform startup window to add a new infobase without a configuration. Empty state is expected in A1. The supplied native probe instead creates a separate workspace, loads original Nexus metadata and executes BSL. Creating an infobase alone does not establish that a complete service application exists.
Know what a copy preserves
Configuration sources describe structure and code. They do not back up particular customers or documents. An infobase dump transfers its state, but usefulness is established by restoring elsewhere and inspecting the result. A file with the expected extension is weak evidence by itself.
Copying an active file infobase can capture inconsistent state. Close sessions first and follow the official dump/restore workflow. Do not keep Designer and a training-edition user session open together because the edition allows only one session. Preserve earlier attempts: a new test should not destroy evidence of the previous failure.
Copying between trajectories
Moving from A to P creates new work with a new ID and source provenance. Content may be copied, but completion, test results and assessment from the source trajectory are not awarded. The candidate applies this mechanism only to local learning notes; an actual infobase must be copied separately with official tools.
Record source course, target course, new ID, date and synthetic-data status. Edit the new note and reopen the source. If the original text also changes, you have shared a reference or overwritten it rather than making an independent copy. The software model needs a deep copy; infobase work needs a separate restore destination.
Acceptance and its limits
A1 acceptance includes explaining layers, modes and objects, a navigation protocol, a separate infobase and evidence that the source survives. Nexus completion is learner self-report, not a protected exam. Author automation demonstrates a particular probe on a specified version, not a learner’s personal performance.
Without the official platform, theory, diagrams, questions and notes remain available offline. Leave the native lab unattested. You may enter P1 directly: A is not a mandatory prerequisite for P. Before continuing, preserve the environment record, control results and explicitly untested items.

lessons.text:
Choosing the infobase, mode and a safe working copy
Prepare your own copy of a real learning solution and prove where changes persist while preserving earlier work.
A1; platform, configuration and data distinctions.
A dedicated official installation. Never target earlier A1/P1 infobases for loading.

Choosing the infobase is part of the task
A1 used an in-memory model of three requests. The A2/P2 workspace is different: it persists three customers, two services and two documents. Do not carry the earlier 105-minute expectation into A2. Its source documents contain 30 and 45 minutes, totaling 75. Record configuration revision 0.2.0-a2p2 and the complete platform build; matching window titles do not establish matching contents.
Before starting, record the purpose, a safe directory alias and your work identifier. Never select an organization’s production infobase or an unknown source for this experiment. The course gate creates a previously absent output directory, does not inspect other infobases and adds no startup-list entries. Apply the same rule manually: know the target in advance and keep the source available.
Distinguish the two operating modes
In 1C:Enterprise mode, a learner works with customers, services and requests through forms. Designer changes the solution definition and performs loading, checking and maintenance. Loading XML in Designer is not ordinary customer entry. After preparing the workspace, open Enterprise mode for user practice. Do not update the database configuration of an arbitrary infobase merely because the command is available.
The automated gate uses the thick client in managed application mode. A compilation directive restricts the query-based test module to that context. This does not establish execution in a web client, thin client or server cluster. If your environment differs, record the difference and perform a separate check before transferring conclusions. Do not rewrite environment details to resemble the sample.
Sources do not back up application records
Configuration.xml, object files and BSL define structure and behavior. They can create a new configuration, but do not contain the particular C001–C003 customers or A200001–A200002 documents. An infobase holds record instances; a .dt dump transfers its state. A2 verifies restoration with actual application records, so the mere existence of a dump file is insufficient.
Restoration into a new infobase should preserve counts, customer references, document numbers and object identity. An object GUID may legitimately match in the source and restored copy. The new work has its own workspace ID and storage location. Replacing every record GUID would defeat state restoration and could break relationships rather than demonstrate independence.
Use a control experiment
The gate fills source-base, repeats the fill operation and opens a new session. It then restores copy-base, compares identity snapshots and changes only its second document from 45 to 60 minutes. Reopening the copy yields 90; separately reopening the source still yields 75. Together these observations establish independence of the selected instances. A window title containing “copy” does not.
Keep the source and restored work, safe protocols and differences. Infobases, dumps and private logs remain local. In Nexus, store learning notes separately by course; copying a note creates new work without awarding another course’s completion. Without an installed platform you may study theory and diagrams, but the unperformed native lab remains NOT RUN.

lessons.title: Catalogs: items, references and matching names
lessons.text:
Catalogs: items, references and matching names
Work with customers and services while distinguishing identity, presentation and editable objects, without creating accidental duplicates.
A2.1; a separate workspace copy with three customers and two services.
Distinguish catalog type, item, reference and presentation.
Find a customer by code and verify a document relationship.
Explain idempotent seeding and the limits of name-based lookup.
Catalog structure and particular records
A catalog defines similarly structured data. Customers is a configuration object; C001 and C002 are particular catalog items. Each learning item has a code and description; a service also has an hourly rate. A list displays item presentations. A list row is not an additional customer. Filtering and sorting change the visible set or order without creating or deleting records.
Inspect all three items: C001 is Training customer Alpha, C002 is Training customer Beta, and C003 is also Training customer Alpha. The repeated description is intentional. Treating matching names as identical records can connect a document to the wrong customer. Check the code and reference first. Matching presentation proves neither duplication nor matching identity.
Reference versus editable object
A reference identifies one particular item. A document can store and compare it without copying all customer attributes. An editable object is obtained when changing values and writing them. Modifying a local object field and persisting that object are different events. Reading through a fresh object or a new session checks persistence rather than merely observing a form buffer.
A row number, selected cell or displayed description cannot replace a reference. Sorting can move the same customer to another position. The first A2 request stores a reference to C001; identically named C003 must not replace it automatically. Native case A2.reference-links checks the relationship. Snapshots record identifiers to detect object substitution during restoration.
Lookup by code and safe creation
The learning function КлиентПоКоду first looks up the specified code. An empty reference causes creation, assignment and writing; an existing item is returned without overwriting its description. Repeating the seed operation should therefore neither increase customer count nor reset someone’s edits. In a real system, key selection would require explicit uniqueness and concurrency decisions.
This is a sequential file-mode workspace, not proven multiuser synchronization. Another session could theoretically insert the same key between lookup and writing; A2 does not study that case. Name-based lookup is not a universal duplicate check either: different customers may legitimately share a description. Never turn repeated names into an instruction to delete records.
Accept the result precisely
Reconcile customer counts and codes, the two document references and service rates S001=600 and S002=900. Checks must detect wrong data, not merely an absence of crashes. Three rows without codes are weak evidence because the record set or relationships could have changed. For a renaming experiment, first create a separate copy, predict reference behavior and reopen the document afterward.
In user practice, choose a customer through the reference field. Typing a name into a comment does not establish a relationship. The browser learning table explains a record set but changes no 1C catalog. Distinguish model outcomes from actual forms or native-gate observations in your protocol. Saving a Nexus note likewise does not persist an infobase item.

lessons.title: Documents: creation, persistence and request state
lessons.text:
Documents: creation, persistence and request state
Create and verify a learning document, distinguishing form edits, persisted attributes and posting, and explain rejected writes.
A2.1–A2.2; customer and service references.
Reconcile document number, date, references, minutes and state.

A document represents a particular event
Unlike the customer catalog, a document represents one service request. It has a number, date, customer reference, service reference, duration, state and comment. Its number is useful for lookup but does not replace its reference. In the fixed dataset, A200001 points to C001/S001 with 30 minutes; A200002 points to C002/S002 with 45. Dates are explicit so the test does not depend on the current day.
Do not infer real business rules from this learning model. It defines no invoices, payments, employee time accounting or material consumption. The total 75 is solely the sum of two document duration fields. Calling it revenue would require decisions about rates, currency, rounding and accounting meaning. Always state the unit, selected records and calculation rule alongside a result.
An open form, writing and reading again
Creating a document produces a new object; editing a form changes its editable state. Writing invokes object rules and persists an admissible state. Before a successful write, an on-screen value does not prove persistence. Close and reopen the document, or start a new session. The native gate does this in its separate REOPEN operation, reading the original total 75 from persisted objects.
A “saved” message or an open window is insufficient evidence. Verify the intended number and relationships, minutes, state and document count after reading again. An empty list may result from a filter and does not by itself establish a failed write. First identify the infobase, object and record selection, then compare expected and observed values.
Writing is different from posting
Posting can reflect an operation according to configuration rules, for example by creating register records. A2 explicitly disables posting in metadata. Both documents are saved with Posted=False. The first nevertheless has business state New and the second In progress. The request state is a separate enumeration attribute; it is neither the posting flag nor evidence of payment.
Do not “repair” the absence of posting by enabling it casually. That would need register design, movement algorithms and negative checks as a new stage. A2’s correct result is precisely persisted, unposted documents. Native case A2.saved-not-posted and the business-state check are considered together to prevent confusing the two meanings.
Rejected writing is observable behavior
The object module rejects an empty customer or service, minutes outside 0..1440, and an empty state before writing. A rejection must prevent persistence of the invalid new document. The gate tests two particular cases: an empty customer and negative minutes. After catching rejection it counts the documents again; two must remain. An error message without a state check would not prove that invalid data was absent.
Zero minutes is permitted here while an empty customer reference is not: field meaning determines the rule. This example does not cover arbitrary text or financial rounding. lessons.text:
Navigation: lists, object forms and a verifiable work history
Build a repeatable user workflow and distinguish list presentation, form buffers and persisted object state.

Lists show selections; forms establish object context
A list supports finding and comparing objects. An object form displays the selected object’s attributes; a selection form returns a reference to another field. These are different tasks even when windows look similar. For requests, first verify the number, then customer and service references. “The second row” is not a stable way to identify A200002 because ordering can change.
The platform can generate standard forms from metadata. Our original workspace contains the TrainingService subsystem, catalogs and request document; available commands depend on platform settings and permissions. Record workflows by object and operation names rather than button coordinates. If a command is unavailable, record that observation and check the mode and solution. Do not import another vendor configuration just to obtain a familiar screen.
Filters combine rather than replace each other
In the learning dataset, A200001 belongs to C001 and is New; A200002 belongs to C002 and is In progress. Filtering by C001 leaves one document and 30 minutes. Adding In progress produces an empty intersection. That is an expected result of two conditions, not lost data. To see A200002, clear the customer filter before selecting its state. Clearing both filters restores two requests and 75 minutes.
Sorting changes order but not the selected set’s total. Distinguish an empty table from loading failure or denied access. Inspect active filters, operating mode and data source. The A2 browser model uses the same synthetic composition for reasoning practice; it does not query your infobase. Its behavior cannot establish LIVE PASS for the actual 1C user interface.
Following references and unsaved edits
When opening a customer from a document, check code C001 rather than only the Alpha description. The other Alpha, C003, demonstrates why context matters. Navigating back or reopening an item through history opens a known object; navigation is not a write command. Edits can remain in an open form buffer. To cancel deliberately, close without saving and reopen the object to inspect its persisted state.
History behavior and command positions depend on the interface. Your protocol can simply record the source object, action, destination and rereading method. Navigation history is different from data change history. The latter requires a separately configured mechanism. A2 does not claim enabled infobase version history, user auditing or cloud learning-event logging.
Accept A2 as a connected workflow
The closing workflow starts with a separate work record, visits customers and two requests, verifies filters and references, and ends with fresh reading. Include an empty-intersection negative case and explain it using the data. Perform write experiments on a separate copy: the source must remain 75 while the changed copy yields 90. Label form observations separately from native-gate results because they exercise different mechanisms.
Attach an action table, safe screenshots or observed values, a work identifier and limitations. A screenshot lacking filters and an object number is difficult to assess. Nexus completion remains local self-report: it preserves an attempt but verifies neither authorship nor actual infobase state automatically. A3 will deepen search and data quality; P can be studied without transferring A completion.

lessons.title: Input checks
lessons.text:
Input checks
Validate required fields and distinguish missing values from a valid zero.
1c-enterprise.a 2; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.
Validate required fields and distinguish missing values from a valid zero.
Save a 30-minute request with selected references.

Start from a rule
Required fields follow the task. A request needs a customer, service and admissible duration; its comment may be empty. A visual marker helps but does not replace object-level rules: data can arrive through another route. Specify field, type, range and rejection message before entering data instead of judging completeness by appearance.
Operators verify persisted outcomes, not just entered values. Prepare an identity/customer/status/minute control table before starting. Refer to it after each action rather than remembering the last screen. Hidden filters matter:an absent visible row does not mean deletion. A reliable workflow explains both what changed and which source records must remain unchanged.
Zero can be meaningful
Zero duration can represent an initial consultation when the requirements permit it. An empty customer reference has no such meaning. A universal “everything nonempty” check both admits invalid data and rejects valid data. Metadata tree
Read the metadata tree as a type schema rather than infobase records.

Definition and instance
Catalogs/Customers defines a type; Alpha and Beta are data instances. Adding an attribute changes the definition for all elements; entering a customer changes data only. This distinction determines the correct mode and backup. Identify whether a change affects schema, a record, presentation or a user variant before acting.
Begin by asking whether an existing setting solves the request. A personal list variant needs no storage change; an absent required attribute needs a model and rules. The tree expresses relationships
A document’s Customer attribute stores a typed reference, not an arbitrary name string. RequestStatus enumeration defines states; a subsystem groups commands. Trace document→attribute→type→catalog. The path locates a field’s source and helps predict renaming consequences without opening every branch at random.
Field types determine operations and boundaries. A string identifier preserves leading zeros, a number supports arithmetic, and a reference supports identity. Specify ordinary, empty and maximum-value examples before applying. Define old-record behavior separately:new fields must not silently rewrite the meaning of an accepted request. Check both existing and newly created documents.
Names serve different purposes
An object name is used in code and configuration structure; its synonym serves the user. Changing Customers’ displayed synonym does not create a catalog or change data references. Renaming the technical name affects references in code and needs verification. An object UUID is not a decorative field to replace arbitrarily.
Applying a change differs from saving development text. Compare editable and database configurations, review the intended diff and restructuring warnings. Update a separate copy and repeat user workflows. A technically valid schema can behave incorrectly, so combine configuration checking with input, writing, reports and fresh reads of old data. One layer does not establish the others.

Perform any change as a separate copy experiment. Architectural observation then avoids accidental data migration, and a mistaken interpretation can be corrected without losing the source.
Rollback preserves data state as well as code. Renaming a removed field back cannot recover lost values. Verify backup by restoring to a fresh directory and reconciling control records. One request can have several solutions

Updating and checking changes

Roles describe capabilities
An operator creates and reads requests; a consultant configures variants; a developer changes configuration. These are teaching roles, not a complete production policy. Specify object, action and data scope per operation. Full access for everyone hides the symptom rather than solving responsibility boundaries.
Begin administration with responsibility boundaries:operators correct input, developers algorithms, and administrators the permitted environment/recovery. Being able to execute a command does not authorize consequences. Record purpose, source, destination and prohibited changes before acting; record outcome and preservation afterwards. Visibility is not permission
Hiding a command can improve UI, but denial must apply to the operation. Another list or programmatic route must not bypass the rule. Denying everything is also incorrect. Alongside each denial, test a necessary allowed operation for the same role.
A full backup restores data, not merely earlier code. Preserve platform/configuration versions, control identities and totals. Restore only to a fresh destination without someone else’s work. Diagnosis and escalation
Prepare a reproducible support request without data leakage or dangerous repairs.
